evidence.dom_irr_rep_dur: (2026-07-28更新)hits抽出には堀記述が無かったが、10-K FY2025原本 Item1(Overview/Product Families/R&D/Patents and Intellectual Property/Manufacturing/Customers,Sales and Marketing/Competition)を直接精読し dom(既出)/irr/rep/dur を充填。個別根拠は下記エントリ
evidence.irr: 移行摩擦の実在: Item1 Customers, Sales and Marketing『Our products typically require a highly technical sales and applications engineering effort where we assist our customers in the design and use of our products in their application. We maintain a staff of applications engineers who work directly with our customers' engineers in the development of their systems' electronics containing our products. Once we secure our product positioning through our technical sales and applications engineering efforts, we then sell our products to end customers...』＝顧客基板への設計組込み。Overview はアナログICの市場特性として『longer product life cycles...relative complexity of design and process technologies, importance of experienced design engineers』を挙げ、R&D節で『the life cycles of our products are typically over 10 years』、MD&Aで『our sales cycle generally takes a number of quarters after we receive an initial customer order for a new product to ramp up』『lengthy sales cycles for our products』。採用後の差し替えは基板再設計と再評価を伴い、製品寿命10年超にわたり固着する。一方 唯一供給・規格ロックは原本が否定: Competition『The analog and mixed-signal semiconductor industry is highly competitive』『Our industry is characterized by decreasing average selling prices over the life of a product』、主要競合を実名10社列挙(Analog Devices, Infineon, NXP, ON Semiconductor, Power Integrations, Renesas, ROHM, Semtech, STMicroelectronics, Texas Instruments)、販路も『Our resellers may second source other products』＝二次調達可、受注は『our customers can cancel or reschedule orders without incurring a significant penalty』。→ 高摩擦移行困難 irr=70。出典: SEC 10-K FY2025 mpwr20251231_10k.htm Item1 Overview/R&D/Customers,Sales and Marketing/Competition、Item7 MD&A
evidence.rep: 原本が複製困難性を明示: Item1 Overview『There are several key factors that distinguish the analog and mixed-signal IC markets from digital IC markets. These factors include longer product life cycles, numerous market segments, technology that is difficult to replicate, relative complexity of design and process technologies, importance of experienced design engineers...』。実体的裏付け: Manufacturing『In contrast to many fabless semiconductor companies, which utilize standard process technologies and design rules established by their foundry partners, we have developed our own proprietary process and packaging technologies and collaborate with our foundry partners to install our technologies on equipment in their facilities for use on our behalf』(ファブレスでありながら自社プロセスをファウンドリ設備に実装＝異例)、Patents『we had 2,231 patents/applications issued or pending, of which 654 patents have been issued in the U.S....Our issued patents are scheduled to expire at various times through December 2045』かつプロセス技術は『maintaining those process technologies as trade secrets』(営業秘密=期限なし)、人材面は『personnel with highly skilled analog and mixed-signal design engineering expertise are scarce』『Analog engineers with advanced skills are limited in number and difficult to replace』。→ 数十年/$10B級の複製不能(100)は資産規模(売上$2.79十億・ファブレス)から支持されないが、プロセス知+営業秘密+希少人材の蓄積で極困難 rep=80。反対証拠として競合は『many of which have substantially greater financial and other resources』かつASPは製品寿命中に低下する点を併記。出典: SEC 10-K FY2025 mpwr20251231_10k.htm Item1 Overview/Manufacturing/Patents and Intellectual Property、Item1A 人材リスク
evidence.dur: 堀の型の分類。規制免許型でもネットワーク型でもブランド型でもなく、原本が示す源泉はプロセス知(製造プロセス・パッケージ技術のノウハウ): 『we have developed our own proprietary process and packaging technologies and collaborate with our foundry partners to install our technologies on equipment in their facilities for use on our behalf. This close collaboration and control over the manufacturing process have historically resulted in favorable yields and product performance for our ICs』、『we have elected to pursue patent protection for aspects of our circuit and device designs...and to protect our manufacturing process technologies by maintaining those process technologies as trade secrets』、『In the area of process and packaging technologies, we are investing in research and development resources to provide leading-edge analog power processes...We believe process technologies are key strategic components to our future growth』。→ 型=プロセス知 dur=100(型の分類であり強度ではない。強度側はdom=50・moatW=50・rep=80に反映済で、競合10社との高競争下である点は変わらない)。副次的にスイッチングコスト型(設計組込み・製品寿命10年超)も併存するが主源泉はプロセス知。出典: SEC 10-K FY2025 mpwr20251231_10k.htm Item1 Manufacturing/R&D/Patents and Intellectual Property
